method.seed_assignment: Assign decision-trace timestamps to the most recent Seed log marker within each arm.
method.state_identity: Compare complete in-combat decision-trace snapshots excluding action, timestamp, source, decision_path, and available_commands.
method.effective_action: Use ai_decision_trace_clean.jsonl and CALLBACK Got action as deployed actions; use RL returned only as pre-guard model output.
method.outcome_check: Compare within-turn state progression and paired run-record fields.

findings.evidence: The deployed action sequence matches through Infernal Blade on floor 30 turn 3, after which the generated attack is Whirlwind for candidate and Cleave for parent. No shared state has a different deployed action.
findings.run_record_effect: current_hp_per_floor and damage_taken differ, but floor reached and killed_by remain tied.
findings.causal_interpretation: Not attributable to a same-state candidate policy choice from the retained trace.

findings.evidence: All per-floor/per-turn deployed action sequences match. A floor 25 turn 4 hand differs before the same Pommel Strike+ action, showing state drift without a preceding retained same-state action difference.
findings.causal_interpretation: Not attributable to a same-state candidate policy choice from the retained trace.

findings.evidence: On floor 22 turn 4, candidate orders Wild Strike then two Heavy Blades; parent orders two Heavy Blades then Wild Strike. Both reach Snecko HP 38 with energy 1 and block 5 before ending the turn.
findings.guard_note: An earlier floor 3 raw parent Colorless Potion output is replaced by POTION_SAVE_GUARD with the same Strike emitted directly by candidate.

findings.evidence: On floor 5 turn 3, candidate plays Strike then Bash+; parent plays Bash+ then Strike. Both kill the 18 HP Cultist in the same turn.
Candidate first targets the 7 HP Louse. Parent raw EndTurn is replaced by ENERGY_GUARD with a Strike targeting the 4 HP Louse. Both emit three Strikes and kill both Louses in the same turn.

training_implication: Do not treat these five raw divergences as superior-action labels. The three attributable deployed differences are locally outcome-neutral, while the other two are not same-state policy comparisons.
next_step: Use retained replay to identify a materially different objective with repeated deployment-relevant errors, especially guard interventions or boss-preparation decisions, before registering another candidate or spending more live games.
